# AISixteen

> AISixteen is an independent developer. Its main product is Aisixteen Fantastic (https://aisixteen.com/fantastic/), an open-source kernel of agents built from scratch at every layer. It also makes small, fast, private apps for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch: no accounts, no tracking, and no personal data ever leaves the user's device.

Full text of the site for LLMs: https://aisixteen.com/llms-full.txt

## About
- No account or sign-up is required for any app, and there are no subscriptions.
- No personal data is collected, stored, or transmitted by any app.
- Every app works offline, except Earth Around, which fetches public NOAA space-weather feeds to show live readings (it still collects nothing about the user).
- Ephemeris Sky computes offline too; charts a user saves sync through that user's own private iCloud container, never through AISixteen servers.
- Apps are downloaded from the Apple App Store. Fantastic, the developer software, is installed from crates.io or GitHub.

## Apps
- [Ephemeris Sky](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6782659268): Real geocentric planetary positions, aspects and a live chart wheel for any moment, plus your saved natal chart with transits, synastry that ranks every contact between two charts, scored dignities and chart balance, solar and lunar returns to the minute, house systems (Placidus, Koch, Whole Sign and more), and an event timeline of ingresses, lunations and aspects. Computed on-device; saved charts sync through your own iCloud. (Sky & science)
- [Overtone Lab](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6787524729): Twenty exact, reference-validated audio tools — tempo, SMPTE, pitch and harmonics, room acoustics, filters, and LUFS loudness. Offline and private. (Creative tools)
- [Indox Text](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1603883417): On-device AI that summarizes articles, documents, and web pages using the device's CPU and Neural Engine. Works offline; iPhone, iPad, Mac, and a Safari extension. (AI & utilities)
- [Typing Mill](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1631148042): Typing practice with real words across four difficulty levels, in an animated interface. (AI & utilities)
- [Golden Ratio Calculator](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1570841203): Reactively calculates the lesser, greater, and whole parts of the golden ratio with professional precision. (Creative tools)
- [Golden Ratio Calculator Lite](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1570956847): A simple, streamlined golden-ratio calculator for quick design work. (Creative tools)
- [Big Pink Cat](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6497066161): A cosmic, choose-your-path interactive story. (Games)
- [Skyscraper Frog](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1563057204): An 8-bit game about guiding a frog across the rooftops of the tallest skyscrapers. (Games)
- [Monstro Shooter](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6752858611): An intense top-down wave-survival shooter across Mars deserts and asteroid fields. (Games)
- [Kerf Calc](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6788179502): An offline construction field calculator — feet-inch-fraction math plus framing (rafters, stairs to code), concrete, rebar, roofing and materials; each tool shows the formula and the code it cites. (Creative tools)
- [AirCore: HVAC Calculator](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6799999307): An offline air-side HVAC calculator — enter any two of dry bulb, wet bulb, dew point, relative humidity, humidity ratio, enthalpy or specific volume and it solves the whole moist-air state on a real psychrometric chart, corrected for site elevation rather than sea level. Also air-side heat, air mixing by mass, duct sizing from friction, fan laws, and pipe sizing by Darcy and Hazen-Williams. It computes air properties and sizes; it has no fitting library and does not do load calculations. iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. (Creative tools)
- [Storypole](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6796056413): An offline job-site calculator for carpenters and framers — feet-inch tape math, equal spacing and on-center layout, board feet with nominal-vs-dressed lumber sizes, roof pitch and rafters, miters and bevels, concrete takeoff and wire gauge. iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. (Creative tools)
- [Par](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6795570043): An offline financial calculator with ten tools — time value of money, amortization, bonds, cash flow, day count, depreciation, percent, rate conversion, real estate and statistics — where every displayed number traces to a cited authority (US Treasury, CFPB Regulation Z and DD, IRS, NIST). Built for loan officers, underwriters, fixed-income desks and exam candidates. (Creative tools)
- [Marine Nav](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6795571481): An offline marine navigation toolkit — tide and tidal-current predictions with slack water, celestial sight reduction from sextant altitude, magnetic declination from the World Magnetic Model, and great-circle distance and bearing. Works with no signal at sea. (Sky & science)
- [Earth Around](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6794748918): Live space weather — NOAA G/R/S storm scales, solar wind speed and Bz, GOES X-ray flare flux, tonight's aurora chance and view line, and Hp30 at 30-minute resolution. iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. Needs a connection for live readings; no account, no tracking. (Sky & science)
- [TrueCourse E6B](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6788926819): A modern E6B flight computer for pilots and CFIs — wind triangle, true airspeed and Mach, density altitude, nav log, fuel, climb/descent, and weight & balance, computed from validated FAA and ICAO Standard Atmosphere formulas. Offline, no account. (Sky & science)

## Developer software
- [Aisixteen Fantastic](https://aisixteen.com/fantastic/): An open-source (AGPL-3.0-or-later), alpha-stage kernel of agents, built from scratch layer by layer — models, programs, files, shells, a browser canvas and the human are all agents in one tree, reached with one call, `send`; every agent describes itself via `reflect`. Available today: the `fantastic` CLI, one static binary for macOS and Linux (arm64, x86_64) and Windows (x86_64), with a terminal UI, a browser canvas and an MCP server for coding CLIs; and the kernel library in Python (reference), Rust, Swift and TypeScript, kept identical by a shared contract corpus. In development, not released: an Apple client (SwiftUI) and a relay. On the public roadmap (https://github.com/orgs/aisixteen/projects/1), not shipped: a Tauri desktop app with Home and skins (in progress), then fantastic OS, a Debian headless kiosk image with system agents (planned). Free; install with `cargo install fantastic` (crates.io: https://crates.io/crates/fantastic) or a prebuilt binary; source at https://github.com/aisixteen/fantastic. Unlike the apps above it is not on the App Store.

## Guides
- [How do you read an ephemeris?](https://aisixteen.com/ephemeris-sky/blog/how-to-read-an-ephemeris/): An ephemeris lists where the Sun, Moon and planets are at a set time each day. How to read the columns, convert your time, and interpolate a position. (Ephemeris Sky)
- [What is the difference between Placidus, Koch and Whole Sign houses?](https://aisixteen.com/ephemeris-sky/blog/house-systems-compared/): Six house systems compared by how each one divides the sky: Whole Sign, Equal, Placidus, Koch, Campanus and Regiomontanus, and why some fail near the poles. (Ephemeris Sky)
- [How do you calculate RT60 and room modes for a small room?](https://aisixteen.com/overtone-lab/blog/rt60-and-room-modes/): The Sabine equation for reverberation time, axial room-mode frequencies and the Schroeder frequency, worked for one 5 × 4 × 2.7 m room, with the limits of each. (Overtone Lab)
- [Can you summarize documents without uploading them?](https://aisixteen.com/indox-text/blog/summarize-documents-on-device/): On-device summarization keeps the text on your iPhone, iPad or Mac. How it differs from cloud tools, what it is good at, its limits, and how to verify it. (Indox Text)
- [How do you learn touch typing?](https://aisixteen.com/typing-mill/blog/how-to-learn-touch-typing/): Touch typing step by step: the home row, which finger takes which key, why accuracy comes before speed, and a short daily practice plan that works. (Typing Mill)
- [How is typing speed measured, and what is a good WPM?](https://aisixteen.com/typing-mill/blog/typing-speed-wpm-explained/): Words per minute counts five characters as one word. How gross and net WPM, accuracy, CPM and KPH are calculated, with examples and what large studies found. (Typing Mill)
- [How do you calculate the golden ratio?](https://aisixteen.com/golden-ratio-calculator/blog/how-to-calculate-the-golden-ratio/): The golden ratio is 1.618. Multiply by 0.618 and 0.382 to split a length, or by 1.618 to extend one. Formulas, worked design examples and common myths. (Golden Ratio Calculator)
- [How do you add, subtract and divide feet, inches and fractions?](https://aisixteen.com/kerf-calc/blog/feet-inch-fraction-math/): Feet-inch-fraction math by hand: convert to inches, work in sixteenths, convert back. Worked examples, a decimal-to-fraction table and the saw-kerf allowance. (Kerf Calc)
- [How do you calculate stair rise and run to code?](https://aisixteen.com/kerf-calc/blog/stair-rise-and-run-to-code/): Divide total rise by the maximum riser, round up, then divide back. A worked stair layout with the IRC and IBC limits for risers, treads, headroom and variation. (Kerf Calc)
- [How do you calculate density altitude and wind correction angle?](https://aisixteen.com/truecourse-e6b/blog/density-altitude-and-wind-correction/): Pressure altitude, density altitude, wind correction angle, groundspeed and crosswind component worked by hand, with the rule of thumb beside the exact value. (TrueCourse E6B)
- [How can you tell whether the aurora will be visible tonight?](https://aisixteen.com/earth-around/blog/will-the-aurora-be-visible-tonight/): What to check before an aurora watch: Bz, solar wind speed, Kp and the view line, how far ahead each one can see, and why darkness and cloud still decide. (Earth Around)
- [What do the Kp index and the NOAA G, R and S scales mean?](https://aisixteen.com/earth-around/blog/kp-index-and-noaa-g-scale/): Kp runs from 0 to 9 and measures geomagnetic disturbance; NOAA's G1 to G5 storm levels map onto it. The R and S scales, Hp30 and what each level does. (Earth Around)
- [How do tide predictions work, and can they be computed offline?](https://aisixteen.com/marine-nav/blog/how-tide-predictions-work/): Tide tables are built by adding harmonic constituents such as M2, S2, K1 and O1. How the method works, what it leaves out, and why it needs no connection. (Marine Nav)
- [How is a loan payment calculated?](https://aisixteen.com/par/blog/how-a-loan-payment-is-calculated/): The loan payment formula worked by hand on a 30-year example, the first rows of the amortization schedule, and how the note rate, APR and APY differ. (Par)
- [How do you lay out studs 16 inches on center, and why does 19.2 exist?](https://aisixteen.com/storypole/blog/stud-layout-16-on-center/): On-center layout from first principles: the 15-1/4" first mark, how many studs a wall needs, the 19.2" diamonds on a tape, and equal spacing for balusters. (Storypole)
- [Why does altitude change HVAC air calculations?](https://aisixteen.com/aircore/blog/altitude-correction-for-hvac-air-calculations/): The 1.08, 4840 and 4.5 factors assume sea-level air. Where they come from, how to correct them for elevation, and a worked airflow example at 5,000 ft. (AirCore)
